leaves.heading: Subscriber access to information
leaves.text: A cable subscriber shall be provided access to all personally identifiable information regarding that subscriber which is collected and maintained by a cable operator. Such information shall be made available to the subscriber at reasonable times and at a convenient place designated by such cable operator. A cable subscriber shall be provided reasonable opportunity to correct any error in such information.

leaves.heading: Destruction of information
leaves.text: A cable operator shall destroy personally identifiable information if the information is no longer necessary for the purpose for which it was collected and there are no pending requests or orders for access to such information under subsection (d) or pursuant to a court order.
Any person aggrieved by any act of a cable operator in violation of this section may bring a civil action in a United States district court.
